hushflow.name: HushFlow
hushflow.free: Core playback and selected ad-supported access are available to start listening.
hushflow.premium: Download supported audio for offline playback when you have permission to access it. Availability depends on the source.

temvica.name: Temvica
temvica.free: Core study planning and focus tools are free to start with.
temvica.premium: Optional on-device study assistance after a model download on supported devices, plus additional customization. Verify generated study material.

how-to-play-audio-with-screen-off-androi.headline: Want a player designed for screen-off listening?
how-to-play-audio-with-screen-off-androi.description: HushFlow is an Android music and podcast player for supported background audio. It still depends on your phone allowing the app to run in the background.
how-to-play-audio-with-screen-off-androi.note: Offline downloads for supported audio are a Premium feature.
how-to-play-audio-with-screen-off-androi.end_headline: Keep listening with your screen locked.
how-to-play-audio-with-screen-off-androi.end_description: If background listening is part of your routine, try HushFlow or explore its features before choosing a player.

how-to-use-a-music-sleep-timer-on-androi.headline: Your player has no sleep timer?
how-to-use-a-music-sleep-timer-on-androi.description: HushFlow includes its own sleep timer for supported audio playing in HushFlow. It does not control playback in an unrelated music app.
benefits: Choose a duration and stop playback automatically
Listen with the screen off while the phone stays on
Manage playback from supported Android media controls
how-to-use-a-music-sleep-timer-on-androi.note: Android battery restrictions can still affect background playback.
how-to-use-a-music-sleep-timer-on-androi.end_headline: Give bedtime audio a stopping point.
how-to-use-a-music-sleep-timer-on-androi.end_description: Try HushFlow's built-in timer for your next listening session. Premium offline downloads are optional.

how-to-block-distracting-apps-on-android.headline: Need stronger boundaries than an app timer?
how-to-block-distracting-apps-on-android.description: Noctra lets you choose distracting Android apps and create blocking rules around the time you want to protect.
how-to-block-distracting-apps-on-android.note: App blocking uses Android Accessibility with your permission; it cannot guarantee a change in habits.
how-to-block-distracting-apps-on-android.end_headline: Protect one useful block of time.
how-to-block-distracting-apps-on-android.end_description: Start with one distracting app and a realistic boundary. Noctra is a tool to support that plan.

how-to-reduce-doomscrolling-on-android.headline: Make the next automatic app-open less automatic.
how-to-reduce-doomscrolling-on-android.description: Noctra adds user-chosen app limits and blocking rules when ordinary reminders are too easy to ignore.
benefits: Notice repeated opens and usage patterns
how-to-reduce-doomscrolling-on-android.note: Pair software boundaries with a replacement activity and a realistic routine.
how-to-reduce-doomscrolling-on-android.end_headline: Turn a scrolling plan into a phone boundary.
how-to-reduce-doomscrolling-on-android.end_description: Try Noctra for the apps that repeatedly interrupt your day. Keep the changes that help you.

digital-detox-plan-for-students.headline: Protect your study block from distracting apps.
digital-detox-plan-for-students.description: If your biggest distraction keeps returning, Noctra can add app boundaries around the study period you chose.
benefits: Review usage without giving up useful technology
digital-detox-plan-for-students.note: Keep essential communication available and choose limits that fit your responsibilities.
digital-detox-plan-for-students.end_headline: Keep one study boundary after the seven-day plan.
digital-detox-plan-for-students.end_description: Use Noctra to support a practical limit rather than trying to remove every app from your life.

no-goon-november-no-nut-november-2026.headline: Looking for a structured November Reset?
no-goon-november-no-nut-november-2026.description: Noctra's separate November 2026 campaign is for adults who want a fixed 30-day digital boundary. Review its protection requirements and eligibility before joining.
benefits: A defined 30-day commitment with progress tracking
no-goon-november-no-nut-november-2026.note: 18+ campaign. Filtering has limitations; Noctra is not medical treatment.
no-goon-november-no-nut-november-2026.end_headline: Read the November Reset details before joining.
no-goon-november-no-nut-november-2026.end_description: See the Noctra campaign rules, supported protection, eligible-market offer and Google Play download in one place.

how-to-remove-porn-addiction.headline: Build a digital boundary alongside your support plan.
how-to-remove-porn-addiction.description: Noctra can add friction around selected apps and supported adult domains. It is a digital-boundary tool, not a diagnosis or treatment.
benefits: Adult Shield for supported adult domains
Protect focused periods on your phone
how-to-remove-porn-addiction.note: If the behavior causes distress or affects daily life, seek qualified professional support. A blocker cannot replace it.
how-to-remove-porn-addiction.end_description: Explore Noctra's tools and limitations before using it as one part of a broader support plan.

how-to-use-pomodoro-for-studying.headline: Want a timer that fits your study plan?
how-to-use-pomodoro-for-studying.description: Temvica combines an Android Pomodoro timer with study planning, so the next focus session begins with a clear task.
how-to-use-pomodoro-for-studying.note: The offline on-device study helper is an optional Premium feature on supported devices.
how-to-use-pomodoro-for-studying.end_description: Choose a task, set a realistic interval and take a proper break. Temvica can help organize that routine.

pomodoro-timer-for-coding.headline: Set a coding interval around one clear objective.
pomodoro-timer-for-coding.description: Temvica provides custom Android focus and break durations for a coding task, debugging pass or documentation session.
benefits: Focus, Flow, Deep and Rest modes
pomodoro-timer-for-coding.note: The timer supports your workflow; it does not guarantee productivity or solve coding tasks.
pomodoro-timer-for-coding.end_headline: Plan your next coding focus block.
pomodoro-timer-for-coding.end_description: Try a Temvica timer for one well-defined coding task, then adjust the interval to fit the work.
